notes.title: New Demo Version (v0.7.0.0)
notes.content:
The presentation of the game has been completely changed with the final product in mind.
We've simplified the mechanics a bit so as not to overwhelm the player, but it's not something we've thrown out, it's just that they're not in the demo now!

[list]
[*]Turrets!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/npCJchA.gif[/img]

[*]New cinematics, which better narrate the beginning of the game.
[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2560090/ss_9341a79d753228aa6ee5ebd103503d8643943c6c.1920x1080.jpg[/img]

[*]Game distribution through levels on a large map
[img]https://i.imgur.com/qv5Okwp.gif[/img]

[*]Automation of gargoyles to allow the player to focus on making runes
[img]https://i.imgur.com/TLKGEqv.gif[/img]

[*]New gods (although it is limited in the demo!)

[*]A “base” from where you will be able to improve skills, talk to the goddess, go to the world map, .... (although in the demo you can only go to the world map and the goddess only talks to you when she requires it).

And much more!
[/list]

notes.title: New demo version (v0.6.1.1)
notes.content:
[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list][*]A third gargoyle that attacks in area has been introduced.[/*]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/yINGGzU.gif[/img]
[*]Modified the design of the book with the intention of making it more eye-catching[/*]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/XQvKn5x.gif[/img]
[*]In addition, if you have upgrades available, every so often it will try to draw the player's attention to remind him of them.[/*]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/YjfKr2c.gif[/img]
[*]The ghost link has a small animation to make it more distinguishable when it is linked and not to be confused with one of your own links.[/*]
[*]When using the mageia that increases the strength of the shadows, its attack looks different.[/*]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vTBCS1m.gif[/img]
[*]The gargoyle's eye flickers if you try to use it when it is out of ammo.[/*]
[*]The stone of the first gargoyle has been modified to be seen more clearly at night.[/*]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/BH1TM4S.gif[/img]
[*]The door and the bone wall release particles when hit and shake slightly.[/*]
[*]Changed the buttons on the rune interface[/*]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/dfwgiyy.jpg[/img]
[*]Modified the summoning tutorial to have a similar format to the rest and remove that half hidden "I understand" button.[/*][/list]
[h2]Pause menu[/h2]
[list][*]Options can now be accessed from here, you don't need to go to the menu to change the sound or language.[/*]
[*]If you go to the menu or try to exit, a confirmation popup will appear indicating that progress will be lost.[/*][/list]
[h2]Main menu[/h2]
[list][*]The candle fire has been changed.[/*]
[*]The ugly menu buttons (such as the skip cinematic) have been moved to the options screen.[/*]
[*]Changed the options screen
[list][*]Modified the buttons layout[/*]
[*]Now you can choose how to treat the cinematics more extensively.
[list][*]View them always[/*]
[*]View them only the first time, if you play again the view ones are skipped[/*]
[*]Skip them always[/*][/list][/*]
[*]There are more options when choosing the amount of runes to start the game with. 
[list][*]4, 6, 8 o 10[/*][/list][/*]
[*]All these choices are saved in persistence, so if you come back to play another day, the same configuration will be there.[/*]
[*]The option to delete this data (the button is a little bit hidden at the bottom left)[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h2]Sounds[/h2]
[list][*]Several new sound effects have been added[/*]
[*]The door being hit or destroyed[/*]
[*]Bone shield when appearing, breaking or being hit[/*]
[*]When using the heal skill[/*]
[*]When using the regeneration skill[/*]
[*]The spikes appearing from the last red mageia[/*]
[*]The summons when they are ready, when you summon them and when they take damage[/*]
[*]The shadows when attacking[/*]
[*]The mageia when they are ready, when you use them or when their effect stops[/*][/list]

notes.title: New Demo Version (v0.6.0.0)
notes.content:
[h1]Major updates[/h1]
[h3]Shadows[/h3]
[list][*]A shadow that attacks the target has been added[/*]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/5Hdug9f.gif[/img]
[*]3 new perks in the book for these shadows[/*]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/gLmwOr6.jpg[/img][/list]
[h3]New Rune System[/h3]
[list][*]The importance of the battlefield has been reduced and more importance has been given to the part of the runes.[/*]
[*]A new rune pool has also been introduced, now the runes are not the same for each run, but are randomized.
[list][*]6 new in Tier 1[/*]
[*]24 new in Tier 2[/*]
[*]34 new in Tier 3[/*]
[*]13 new in Tier 4[/*]
[*]11 new in Tier 5[/*][/list][/*]
[*]Special runes have been introduced
[*]In the demo they are chosen when you unlock new runes, in the final version they will be chosen before the game.[/*]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/MklFLHt.gif[/img]
[*]These special runes differ from each other by color and give a special resource (essence) in addition to the main resource (Arcane).[/*]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/67EmtWN.jpg[/img]
[*]Having just one of these runes unlocks two things:
[list][*]1) New skills to use during the game[/*]
[*]2) The ability to enter "Mageia Synchrony".[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3]Magics (Mageias)[/h3]
[list][*]Magics are used with the essence they generate, the higher the level of the magic, the higher its cost.[/*]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/mx9FQse.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/a4mMdtK.gif[/img]
[*]Synchrony is to enter a special state where each and every rune is converted to the chosen type.[/*][*]The rune nodes change depending on the rune type[/*]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/YkXx7Uz.gif[/img]
[*]In synchrony only the special resource is generated, the main resource is no longer earned (therefore you will not be able to save to buy new skills in the book).
[list][*]It also allows the ability to make combos[/*]
[*]As the combo increases, more essence is gained.[/*][/list][/*]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/R0TDSlF.jpg[/img]
[*]Special runes that already had this type of native form are considered "over power" giving much more essence.[/*]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fC7Ff3J.jpg[/img]
[*]9 new magics[/*]
[*]A new page has been added in the book to read a more accurate description of the magics[/*][img]https://i.imgur.com/xQ3oABR.png[/img][/list]
[h3]Endings[/h3]
[list][*]3 new endings with one cinematic each [/*][/list]
[h1]Minor updates[/h1]
[h3]Gargoyle[/h3]
[list][*]Gargoyles no longer have to be charged, they chage by themselves when added to the dock.[/*]
[list][*]Gargoyle attacks are now instant kills[/*]
[*]Now the unlocked gargoyles do not share the same type, each one is different.[/*]
[*]Now you can take it out of the dock even if it is charing, and when you return it to the dock it continues from where you left off.[/*]
[*]The bar now indicates the charging progress and available charges[/*][img]https://i.imgur.com/hN2ebXu.gif[/img]
[*]Now they move with the left click but attack with the right click.[/*]
[*]The gargoyle's charge bar flashes if you have no ammunition[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3]Vagrant[/h3]
[list][*]The vagrant's bar of suspicion remains even if you scare him away.[/*][/list]
[h3]Runes[/h3]
[list][*]Rune autocompletion has been removed as a perk
[list][*].Autocomplete has been mixed with the preview, now the perk gives you a hint of the correct connections.[/*][/list][/*]
[*]The area of the runes has been enlarged, with some of them now being larger[/*]
[*]Small magnet on the rune nodes to facilitate correct connections[/*]
[*]An option in the menu to be able to play with a smaller number of runes[/*]
[*]Improved the system of random runes, so that the same rune does not appear 3-4 times in a row, or just the same 3 runes as usual.[/*][/list]
[h3]Others[/h3]
[list][*]Skip option in the cinematics (by simply pressing any button for a few seconds).[/*]
[*]New tutorials for this changes.[/*]
[*]The cost of healing increases as you use it.[/*]
[*]Particles when knocking on the door and small shake.[/*][/list]
